title: A Novel Way to Express Gratitude
author: Admired Leadership
summary: This article offers a specific, low-cost gesture for leaders whose usual gratitude tools, meals, notes, small gifts, have lost their novelty through repetition. The suggestion is simple: write out a genuine, comprehensive list of a team member's strengths as the leader sees them, framed with a short explanatory sentence, and give it to them as a standalone document. The author argues that seeing how a leader specifically views their strengths, laid out in writing, is a rare and powerful experience for most people. The piece predicts that recipients will keep and re-read the list whenever they need a confidence boost.
points: Common gratitude gestures like meals or handwritten notes can lose their impact through repetition
A novel alternative: write a comprehensive list of a team member's strengths as the leader genuinely sees them
The list needs only a brief framing sentence before the strengths themselves
Recipients often keep and re-read such a list whenever they need a confidence boost
quotes: Finding a novel expression of gratitude that truly lands with others is not always obvious.

The next time you want to express your gratitude for a team member, consider giving them a comprehensive list of their strengths, as you see them, simply but powerfully articulated on a sheet of paper.
When I think of you and the many contributions, talents, and skills you bring to our team, these are your strengths that stand out to me.
Learning how a leader views their strengths can be an amazing experience for a team member and expresses the leader’s gratitude like very few other expressions can.
Don’t be surprised if the team member not only saves the note but pulls it out to read it whenever they need a boost of confidence or validation about their value.
